name: Fleur
source:
Fleur is Leah's colleague from the school they both work at together. Bubbly and caring, Fleur makes it her mission to mother Leah. She becomes concerned about Leah when she starts to withdraw from work, though Leah sees her as more of a busybody and a gossip. Once Fleur has set her sights on helping someone, she is relentless in attempting to fix things for them.

[From [url=https://melancholy-marionette.itch.io/apartment-no9]itch.io[/url]]
